newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Keppel FELS - Goldman.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Keppel FELS - Goldman.

text.p: Goldman Sachs has maintained its buy recommendation for Keppel FELS Ltd and said its 12-month price target for the company's share is Singapore $7.50-S$8.
FELS ended down two cents at S$4.34 on Tuesday on a thin turnover Of 29,000 shares.
"We believe the worst is over and news coming out of the company is likely to provide positive surprises," said Ang Lay Pheng in Goldman's April 15 research report on FELS.
She said FELS was expected to announce several jackup orders and a major semisubmersible conversion and these contracts should drive up share prices in the next few months.
Ang said the offshore rig fundamentals were still good with day rates for jackups and semisubmersibles firming and utilisation of harsh environment rigs very tight.
"Although the upturn in the newbuild cycle for rigs has been slow to materialise, we believe we are at the start of a rig replacement cycle," she said.
Ang said the stock has been trading at the low end of its historic range and she also put FELS' realizable book value at S$4.70.
